description: session — a one-line state snapshot at session start (branch, uncommitted count, last commit); at Stop, a non-blocking note for the user with the handoff age, .todo count and instructions-audit age (each fact once per session; silent in a linked worktree unless NUDGES_IN_WORKTREE=1). Self-gates: silent outside a git repo / where the files are absent. Kill-switch: SESSION_START_OFF=1.
